Contact

If you have a question or a suggestion, or you found something wrong on this site, please write to us by email.

Contact: ipe.haven@gmail.com

We aim to reply within a few business days.

For a game-specific problem

Each game has its own official site and its own support. Please start there, from the game's card on the home page.

Helpful details to include

  • The page you were on, or the game you mean
  • Your device and browser
  • What happened, with a screenshot if you have one

Frequently asked questions

Can I play any of the games yet?

Not yet. None of the four games is released, and none has a store page. The status of each game is on its card on the home page.

Do you collect personal information?

No. See the Privacy Policy for details.

Where are the terms of use?

This portal has no terms of its own. Terms of use are on the game sites that have them (Inkisle has none yet), linked in the footer.
